chunks: Enter then, my people, the Holy Land that God has ordained for you, and do not turn back, or you will suffer.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Al-Ard Al-Muqaddasah' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often attributed to Prophet Joshua (Yusha ibn Nun) acting on behalf of Moses, emphasizing the transition from the wilderness to the promised land as a test of steadfastness. The command to enter the 'Holy Land' underscores the divine right of the faithful to claim their destiny, while the warning against retreating highlights the spiritual peril of losing momentum in obedience after receiving clear divine decree.
